integrity: Explicit symbolic derivation and reproducible independent direct enumeration through bounded sizes. Independent audit not performed. No infinite claim is justified solely by a finite checker.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty two-agent S5 frames with all propositions admitted. The local nestedness/h-equivalence criterion is previously known; only the exact labelled and unlabelled census and sharp local/global gap are assessed as novel. 2023 related primary full text and complete 2015 thesis were unavailable; no claim of exhaustive historical priority.
title: Exact labelled and unlabelled census of normal two-agent someone-knows frames
